propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge and before closing the ticket, using `git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main`.

The ticket close completion precheck (_referencing_commit_exists) verifies the merged rebar-ticket: commit is reachable from HEAD of the repo_root, and fails if the worktree has not been advanced past the merge.
The shared main checkout must never be fast-forwarded, reset, or stashed during post-merge operations, as it may contain uncommitted operator WIP.
AGENTS.md must document the post-merge fast-forward discipline in the close-discipline section with explicit guidance and a warning against touching the shared checkout.
CONTRIBUTING.md must introduce a new subsection 2f immediately after section 2e to describe the fast-forward-then-close workflow.
